title: An untyped parameter keeps the type of its argument, which the body can test
query: DEFINE FUNCTION StringLength = ( s ) => IF ( ISSTRING ( s ), LEN ( s ), BLANK () )

source.quote: This prevents errors and allows you to decide how to handle non-string input into the function (in this example, returns BLANK ).
source.supports: the page shows this query with the comment "Returns: 5, BLANK"

notes: The page shows the values; the type is that of LEN, an integer.
